classes.name: blue sky law
classes.label: blue sky law
classes.definition: state-level securities regulation, designed to protect investors against securities fraud that require issuers to be registered and to disclose details of their offerings

attributes.name: is Employee Retirement Income Security Act conformant
attributes.label: is Employee Retirement Income Security Act conformant
attributes.definition: indicates whether the security conforms to the Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) of 1974, a federal outline for regulating employee benefit plans, including healthcare plans sponsored and/or insured by an employer

attributes.name: is Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation insured
attributes.label: is Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation insured
attributes.definition: indicates whether the security is covered by Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance

attributes.name: is subject to Federal Reserve Board Regulation T
attributes.label: is subject to Federal Reserve Board Regulation T
attributes.definition: indicates whether a given cash or margin account is subject to Federal Reserve Board (FRB) margin requirements
